subject: Supplier intake: format preferences & PO linking
messages:
From: Sara Jensen <sara@lumensupply.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier intake - file format question & PO linking

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for starting the onboarding. We're preparing the first set of invoices for Redwood (activation batch) and wanted to confirm the preferred intake format and how you want PO references handled. A couple of specifics: 

- File formats we can send: single CSV (one invoice per file), multi-invoice CSV (multiple invoices / lines in one file), PDF attachments, or an SFTP/portal upload. We also have an option to post via an HTTP webhook if you prefer structured API ingestion.
- Many of our invoices include multiple PO numbers across line items. Do you prefer: (A) PO numbers on the invoice header (one PO per invoice), (B) PO numbers at the line level (a PO column per line), or (C) a separate mapping file that links line ids to PO numbers?
- Any mandatory columns you require for the CSV? We currently include: invoice_number, invoice_date, vendor_name, currency, total_amount, line_description, quantity, unit_price, po_number (optional), po_line_ref (optional), tax_amount, shipping_amount.

I've attached a small sample (lumen_sample_chunked.csv) showing a multi-invoice file with mixed PO coverage. Can you tell us which route is easiest for Redwood to avoid rework? If useful, we can schedule a 20-min call to walk through the sample and run a test upload.

Thanks,
Sara Jensen
Ops Lead, Lumen Supply Co.
attachments: lumen_sample_chunked.csv (CSV / 3 rows per invoice)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara@lumensupply.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier intake - file format question & PO linking

Sara — thanks, this is great context. Quick answers before Vanessa drops in with technical mapping: 

- Preferred: structured CSV upload into our portal is ideal for production (idempotency, ack tokens), but we will accept multi-invoice CSVs by email as a temporary fallback.
- PO linking: line-level PO numbers are the most robust for reconciliation. If you can include a "po_number" column on each line, and a "po_line_ref" when a PO has multiple line items, that will minimize exceptions.
- Mandatory fields: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), supplier_name, currency, total_amount, line_description, quantity, unit_price, po_number (nullable), tax_amount (can be 0).

Vanessa — looping you in to confirm the CSV header names we should give them and to share the mapping sheet. Also CC'ing Ben for visibility on billing exceptions.

If you're open to a short call, can we do 10:30 PT today?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara@lumensupply.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier intake - file format question & PO linking

Hi Sara — thanks for the sample. I'm attaching a short mapping file (redwood_sample-mapping-table.xlsx) with the exact header names we process. A few operational notes below: 

1) Recommended production path: portal CSV upload. Benefits: automated ACK (we return an ack_token per file), idempotency checks on invoice_number + supplier_id, and faster exception routing.

2) Email fallback rules: if you send via email, please attach one CSV per transmission and include "X-Redwood-Vendor-ID: LUMEN-002" in the subject line for automated routing. Keep filenames in the pattern: LUMEN_invoice_YYYYMMDD.csv.

3) PO handling (production): 
   - Column: po_number (string) — put the PO at the line level. If invoice-level only, put PO in po_number on every line.
   - Column: po_line_ref (string) — optional, use when a single PO has multiple separate line items that need mapping.

4) Multi-PO invoices: supported. We will reconcile by matching po_number per line. If a line maps to multiple POs (rare), include separate rows per PO-line and use invoice_line_id to deduplicate.

5) Minimal sample we need for acceptance testing: 3 invoices (one single-PO invoice, one multi-PO invoice, one multi-line single-PO invoice). Send to the portal sandbox or to onboarding@redwoodinference.com with subject: "TEST_UPLOAD LUMEN-002". We'll run a dry ingest and share the ack log.

Attachment: redwood_sample-mapping-table.xlsx (header names + example rows)

Ben — FYI on the routing rules above; please flag anything we should tighten for AP.

Sara — can you confirm you'll produce the three-test CSV and whether you prefer the portal or email for the initial sandbox run? If portal, we'll send a temporary upload link (expires in 48h).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Supplier Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

A couple quick clarifications before we start:
- Timezone for the upload window — we are on US PST and can upload this afternoon (after 2pm PST). Is that ok for you to run the dry ingest and return the ack log within the same business day?
- For multi-PO invoices, we'll include a separate row per PO-line as you recommended and populate invoice_line_id.
